name: bipeur
description: Resurrects the pager as an attention protocol: relays Crew approval requests to a Beeper station and resolves each one from the human's signed decision, wherever the human is.
author: Baptiste Faisy
highlights: Every pending tool approval becomes a page on a real pager screen
A signed decision on the pager resolves the Crew approval exactly once
Denials carry the human's reason back through the native decide form
Journal events reach the Beeper record and the Crew notification bus
Fails closed: an expired page resolves as a denial, never an approval
